title: CDP and LLDP: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: At a conference, people swap business cards. Network devices swap cards with their neighbours. C D P and L L D P are those cards.

lines.t: CDP and LLDP are the cards

scenes.heading: Business cards
scenes.narration: Both protocols advertise who a device is. C D P is Cisco's own, and it's on by default. L L D P is the open standard, and it's off by default. C D P sends a card every sixty seconds. Neither crosses a router, so it only finds direct neighbours.

scenes.heading: Commands
scenes.narration: Check neighbours like this. See your C D P neighbours. Turn on L L D P. And see the L L D P neighbours.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. L L D P is off by default. It stops at the first router. The hold time is longer than the timer.

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.cta: Try the Courseiva CDP and LLDP lab
scenes.narration: So, to recap. C D P is Cisco, and L L D P is the standard. Only C D P is on by default. They find direct neighbours only. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva CDP and LLDP lab.
